verses.text: Ayik 36 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Asa reyal, ix kot winhaj Baasa sreyal Israel yak' owal t'a Judá. Ix scha'anel yich winhaj Baasa chi' sb'oanoch smuroal chonhab' Ramá yik smakan b'e winh yik manhxa mach sk'och t'a yol yik Judá chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yik'elta masanil k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata winhaj rey Asa chi' t'a stemplo Jehová yet' k'e'en ay t'a spalacio winh, ix yak'anb'at k'e'en winh t'a winhaj Ben-adad sreyal Siria kajan t'a Damasco. Ix yalanb'at winh icha tik:

Ko b'o junok ko trato, icha yutejnak sb'a heb' winh ko mam. Tik swak'b'at k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata t'ayach. Ak' lajwok a trato yet' winhaj Baasa sreyal Israel, yik wach' tz'och wa'an winh yak'an owal t'ayin, xchib'at winhaj Asa chi'.

Ix scha sk'ol winhaj Ben-adad tas ix yal winhaj rey Asa chi', yuj chi' ix schekankot juntzanh heb' soldado winh yet' heb' yajalil yik skot heb' yak' owal t'a juntzanh chonhab' yik Israel. Ix yak'an ganar chonhab' Ijón heb', chonhab' Dan, chonhab' Abel-naim yet' juntzanh chonhab' b'aj sik'chajkan ixim trigo t'a yol yik Neftalí.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj Baasa chi', ix yaktan winh sb'oank'e Ramá chi' yuj skolan schonhab'.

Ix yik'anb'at masanil anima winhaj rey Asa chi', haton heb' ay t'a yol yik Judá, ix b'at yik'ankot k'e'en k'e'en heb' yet' te te' toxo ix smolb'ej winhaj Baasa b'aj wan sb'oank'e Ramá chi'. Haxo yet' juntzanh chi' ix sb'ok'e smuroal chonhab' Geba yet' chonhab' Mizpa heb'.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix jawi jun winh schekab' Dios skuchan Hanani t'a winhaj rey Asa chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha heb' soldado yik Siria ix ak'och yipok a k'o'ol, manhok Jehová, yuj chi' toxo ix el heb' t'a yol a k'ab'.

¿Tom maxtzak a nakoti ayik yak'annak owal heb' aj Etiopía yet' heb' aj Libia het'ok? Manhxo jantakok heb' soldado, nok' chej yet' jantak carruaje yik owal yet'nak heb', palta ak'nak ganar heb' yuj Jehová, yujto a ak'nakoch yipok a k'o'ol.

Yujto a Jehová syilnhej masanil tas tzuji t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, sch'oxan spoder t'a heb' tojol syutej spensar t'ay, tato syak'och heb' yipok sk'o'ol sik'lab'il. Haxo tiknaik, a jun tas ix a k'ulej tik, lajan wal icha sk'ulej junok anima malaj spensar. Yuj chi', a tiknaik yet' ol b'eynhej tiempo, aynhej heb' ol ak'an owal het'ok, xchi winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a winh.

Ix kot yowal winhaj rey Asa chi' sik'lab'il t'a winh schekab' Dios chi', ix schekan winh ak'chajoch winh t'a preso. Hanheja' t'a jun pekti' chi', tzijtum heb' t'a yol chonhab' chi' ix ak'jioch sya'elal yuj winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Asa, ayik ix el yich masanto ix lajwi, aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal heb' sreyal Judá yet' heb' sreyal Israel.

Ayik 39 ab'ilxo yoch winh reyal, ix och jun ilya te ow t'a yok winh, palta maj sna sb'a sk'ol winh yuj jun ya'elal chi', manhok t'a Jehová ix yal sb'a winh, palta to ha t'a heb' anhtum b'aj ix b'at winh.
Ayik ix tz'akwi 41 ab'il yoch winh reyal, ix cham winh.

Ix mukji winh b'aj ix schek b'ojok yet'tal t'a schonhab' winhaj David. Niwan perfume ix yak'och heb' t'a yib'anh b'aj ix b'akhchaj sniwanil winh, ix och pax masanil makanhil tas suk'uk'i sjab' t'a winh, haton tas te wach' yaj sb'o'i. Ix yak'anoch jun niwan k'ak' heb' yik sch'oxanel heb' to niwan yelk'och winh t'a sat heb'.
